header.title: Questions & Answers
header.subtitle: Practical answers about pickup, delays, payment, luggage, children, winter travel and accessible vehicles.

cta.title: Still need help?
cta.body: Ask the local dispatch team about a route, vehicle or transport requirement.
cta.prefill: I have a specific question about your transfer services...

recognize.q: How will I recognize my driver at the airport arrivals hall?
recognize.a: Your driver will wait in the arrivals area with a sign showing your name and may contact you on the mobile number supplied with the booking.

delay.q: What happens if my flight or train is delayed?
delay.a: Up to one hour of flight-delay waiting is included. For longer delays, waiting time may be charged; please let dispatch know as soon as you can.

luggage.q: Are luggage and ski/snowboard bags included in the price?
luggage.a: Standard luggage and ski or snowboard bags are included. Specify passenger and equipment quantities when booking so dispatch can assign a suitable vehicle.

deposit.q: Do I need to pay a deposit in advance?
deposit.a: Standard private transfers do not require prepayment. Group coach hire or multi-day bookings may require a deposit; dispatch will confirm this before booking.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Payment is available by cash, bank transfer, or credit card. Ask dispatch in advance if you need a particular payment arrangement or invoice.

children.q: Do you provide child and infant safety seats?
children.a: Yes. Child seats for different ages are available on request. Include the child’s age when booking so dispatch can prepare the right seat.

vehicle.q: How do I know which vehicle is mine at the pickup point?
vehicle.a: Vehicle choice depends on passenger count, luggage, equipment, accessibility needs, and availability. If you prefer a particular vehicle, ask when booking.

stops.q: Can we request rest stops or photo stops on scenic mountain passes?
stops.a: Yes. Ask for a short rest or photo stop when booking so it can be allowed for in the route and timing.

languages.q: What languages do your drivers speak?
languages.a: The local driver team can assist guests in Italian, German, and English. Mention your preferred language when booking.

night.q: Do you operate on-demand local night taxis between Val Gardena villages?
night.a: Yes, during the winter and summer high seasons we operate 24/7 on-demand local taxi dispatch between Ortisei (St. Ulrich), Santa Cristina, Selva (Wolkenstein), ski lifts, and all regional restaurants and nightlife venues.

winter.q: Are your vehicles equipped for severe winter snow and high mountain passes?
winter.a: The fleet includes Mercedes 4MATIC vehicles, and minivans are prepared with winter equipment and external ski carriers during the winter season. Dispatch selects a suitable vehicle for the conditions and group.

bikes.q: Can you transport downhill mountain bikes and e-bikes in summer?
bikes.a: Yes, we operate specialized weatherproof bike trailers accommodating up to 10 mountain bikes or 3 motorbikes for the Sella Ronda MTB Tour and regional transfers.

wheelchair.q: Do you offer wheelchair accessible vehicles for disabled passengers?
wheelchair.a: Yes. A specially adapted vehicle can carry one wheelchair and up to seven passengers. Contact dispatch before booking so the team can confirm availability and your exact access requirements.
